Frontend.reason: Existing quota/regeneration UI remains intact. Writing feedback now creates a V3 sourceReference request from required Cambridge book/Test plus the existing module, Task and essay fields; it migrates V2 local drafts without losing essay text, retains V2 reports, labels automatic recognition as a reference assessment, records the Academic Task 1 missing-image limitation, and uses an opaque mobile-safe action footer. Learning plans now distinguish a dated one-time task from daily/weekly recurrence, collect optional start time/duration and recurring start/end boundaries, resolve Today by concrete local date, separately surface overdue/upcoming one-time tasks, and keep legacy custom plans readable until the learner explicitly re-arranges them.

Backend.reason: The Tracker client gateway contract now accepts only the bounded V3 sourceReference shape alongside legacy V2 submissions, includes it in the private writing snapshot, and requires an automatic-reference limitation in returned feedback. Plan drafts now require the shared once/daily/weekly schedule fields before a user-confirmed local write. Study-plan sync payloads include only the compact schedule rule (scheduledDate or startDate/endDate) rather than materialized future occurrences; actual completions remain the existing per-date plan_execution records. The paired Formal release must accept both contracts, apply the compatible plan-validator migration, and keep the existing quota-reservation authority.

Admin.reason: Lexi Control continues to own provider, prompt and quota policy. Individual learner plan dates are not an administrator-managed or reportable resource; existing Tracker sync aggregate capacity and the updated plan-draft contract explanation cover the operational review, so no additional Tracker-specific control surface is required.

Deployment.reason: Not deployed. Publish only with the paired Formal gateway and backward-compatible Tracker plan-validator migration after both compatible backend contracts are verified. Then smoke-test a V3 writing request, legacy V2 report readability, Task 1 limitation display, single-date and date-bounded recurring plan creation, AI draft confirmation without auto-write, overdue rescheduling, legacy custom readability, compact cross-device sync, quota state and cross-account isolation.

Verification.reason: Focused V3 contract, artifact/export, gateway and report rendering checks must pass together with the new schedule, sync and AI-draft contract tests plus Tracker typecheck/lint. Before a release, run the complete Tracker and Formal verification gates, then perform the paired signed-in production smoke checks.
